review_evidence: README identifies HOLMS as a HOL Light library for modal systems with formal soundness/completeness, Kripke semantics, decidability and countermodel construction for K/D/T/K4/S4/B/S5/GL/Grz.
Representative modal.ml and gl_completeness.ml contain extensive `new_definition`, inductive syntax/semantics, proves and completeness theorems.

make.ml is the library load/navigation surface and tests.ml contains mathematically meaningful modal formulas, provability principles and countermodel examples; both are retained rather than path-name filtered.
summary: Reviewed HOLMS and retained all 40 primary files; this is a substantive modal-logic formalization including meaningful test/example formulas and a navigation loader.

review_evidence: Ran `grep -cE '\b(prove|new_definition|new_axiom|new_recursive_definition|let[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z_]+[[:space:]]*=)\b'` over all 9 files; only make.ml had zero matches (others ranged 24-162).

Read make.ml in full (4989 bytes): copyright-comment header plus `needs`/`loadt` file-inclusion commands loading every other module of the library (calculus.ml, modal.ml, gen_completeness.ml, grz_modular.ml, tests.ml, etc.) in dependency order under section-comment headers -- no declaration of its own.

Read the opening of grz_modular.ml (58737 bytes, the largest file in the unit, 63 matches): `let GRZ_AX = new_definition ...`, `let GRZ_IN_GRZ_AX = prove (..., REWRITE_TAC[...] THEN MESON_TAC[...])`, and further proved lemmas (`GRZ_AX_GRZ`, `S4GRZ_AX`, `GRZ_PROVES_T`, `GRZ_PROVES_4`, `GRZ_EQ_S4GRZ`) building the Grzegorczyk-logic meta-theory.
summary: This unit is HOL Light (.ml files), so the Lean declaration-keyword grep does not directly apply; used the HOL Light-appropriate signals `prove`/`new_definition`/`new_axiom`/`let ... =` instead. Read make.ml in full (4989 bytes, the smallest file and the one with zero matches on that census): a pure loader consisting only of comments and `needs`/`loadt` file-inclusion commands, no declarations of its own -- the HOL Light analog of the pure-import-aggregator pattern (FILTER-007), retained as navigation data. Read the opening of grz_modular.ml (58737 bytes, the largest file in the unit, 63 matches) and confirmed it holds real `new_definition`/`prove` content (e.g. `GRZ_AX`, `GRZ_IN_GRZ_AX`, `GRZ_AX_GRZ`, `GRZ_EQ_S4GRZ`) with full HOL Light tactic proofs. Consistent with the prior review's characterization of this source as a substantive modal-logic formalization. All 9 files stay searchable; no exclusions.
